projects.name: Mubea Portal
projects.delivered: Application catalogue, accounts and roles. Added self-service password changes and immediate revocation of existing Portal and MubeAbsent sessions, including after administrator password resets.
projects.evidence: 197 automated tests passed. Browser verification uses isolated demo accounts.
projects.next: IT confirms the host, domain, HTTPS, backups and operational owner.
projects.stoppers: Corporate hosting and identity decisions; operational acceptance. Local completion does not establish a production deployment.

projects.name: MubeAbsent
projects.delivered: 15 absence codes, configurable rules, employee requests, scoped manager decisions, private team calendar, administrative UA records and reversals. Added a personal activity feed; comments and other employees' events are excluded.
projects.evidence: 86 automated tests passed. Policy defaults remain unconfirmed until HR validates them.
projects.next: HR confirms deductions, eligibility, supporting documents, balances, employee data and the first release scope.
projects.stoppers: HR policy and user acceptance; employee data source; configured notification delivery. The activity feed is available in the application; email delivery is not implemented for this release.

projects.name: Overtime Management System
projects.delivered: Submission, approval, HR assignment, reviewed CSV export, account administration and notification outbox. Browser login now uses HttpOnly session cookies with CSRF protection; existing token API clients remain supported.
projects.evidence: 87 backend tests passed; three PostgreSQL-only concurrency tests skipped on local SQLite. Frontend build and isolated browser workflow passed.
projects.next: Configure and verify the production host, PostgreSQL, sender and notification scheduler with IT.
projects.stoppers: MFA, verified email and recovery remain Phase 2 work. HR acceptance, real delivery and production concurrency checks are required before launch.

projects.name: MSCM Faucon / Investment Monitor
projects.delivered: Three-file SAP import linked by project and WBS identifiers, reconciliation, access scopes, procurement and planning records. Added comparison of compatible dated snapshots using exact decimal amounts; missing projects have no invented delta.
projects.evidence: 27 backend tests passed and frontend build passed. Existing owner data remains unchanged.
projects.next: Finance confirms currency, reporting period and budget definitions, then supplies compatible historical snapshots and project owners/dates.
projects.stoppers: Financial definitions and business acceptance; incomplete project metadata; corporate sign-in and hosting. Planned costs must not be described as approved budgets without confirmation.

projects.name: Mubea Technician Dashboard
projects.delivered: Existing inventory, scanning, labels, assignments, overdue returns and buying guide. Added separate liveness and database-readiness endpoints with generic responses and no user data.
projects.evidence: 17 tests passed and Next.js production build passed. The configured database ping succeeded; local readiness correctly returns 503 while a session signing secret is missing. Production deployment is not verified.
projects.next: PM, Production and IT assess whether SAP meets the technician dashboard requirements or Bluebird should provide the solution. Use the documented tool-tracking process for the assessment.
projects.stoppers: Anna's feedback concerns this application: the local implementation was rejected and SAP / Bluebird must be assessed. The approximate 1-2 day Bluebird estimate is indicative. Platform fit, process ownership and workshop acceptance remain open; deployment instructions are reference material pending that decision.

projects.name: Spare-parts / MRP
projects.delivered: Existing inventory, machine/line classification and Italy workbook import. Added a read-only assessment export: typed data, photos, quality exceptions and SHA-256 manifest. Accounts, passwords and sessions are excluded.
projects.evidence: 26 tests passed and production build passed. Shared stock remains one balance even when a part has multiple machine links.
projects.next: Validate physical stock, locations, classifications and the receiving/issuing workflow with the inventory owner; complete scanner and label-printer acceptance.
projects.stoppers: Physical stock and locations, process ownership, operating arrangements and hardware acceptance remain unconfirmed. Anna's SAP / Bluebird feedback concerns the technician dashboard. The older spare-parts repository is reference material for this same MRP workstream.
